components.name: SalesResults
components.summary: Presents validated sales aggregates of one source, distinct units, comparisons and matched products.

props.name: result
props.meaning: Generated SDK response containing server-owned rows, exact decimal totals, comparison periods and warnings.

props.name: source
props.meaning: Source of the result; selects its measure labels. Defaults to sankhya.

components.accessibility: Native captioned tables, scoped headers, text values beside chart bars, pressed-state view buttons and native details controls.
components.usage: Render only validated API results. Charts are available for monthly data sharing one unit; different quantity units, including VRMaster packaging types, never share a chart or total.

examples.label: Monthly sales with comparison
examples.description: Synthetic decimal sales and prior-year totals; the preview makes no API or provider request.

components.name: SalesAnswer
components.summary: Presents a sales answer with one labeled section per queried source: MNS (Sankhya), Pilar da Terra (VR Master) or both.

props.name: answer
props.meaning: Generated SDK agent result: the selection and a section per source with its status, reason and result.

components.accessibility: Each source is a group named by its level-2 heading, not a landmark, so repeated answers stay distinct; status text explains a missing result without relying on color.
components.usage: Never add figures across sections: each source keeps its own totals, and a failed source is reported beside the other source's result.

examples.label: Both sources, one unavailable
examples.description: Synthetic Tudo answer with a Sankhya total and an unavailable VRMaster; the preview makes no API or provider request.
